title: Frozen confirmation of dual-capacity transductive prototype refinement

development_dependency.selection_note: DCCR failed its gate. The simpler BL refinement arm is frozen as DCTPR for untouched-episode confirmation, not re-described as a successful DCCR result.

method.name: DCTPR
method.features: L2-normalized concatenation of individually normalized frozen DINOv2-B/14 and DINOv2-L/14 CLS features
method.initial_prototypes: one labelled support feature per class
method.prototype_update: normalized equal mixture of the labelled support and the current soft query centre

comparators: BL balanced Sinkhorn without prototype refinement
B-only prototype refinement with the same inference budget
L-only prototype refinement with the same inference budget

go_no_go.episode_consistency_gate: DCTPR exceeds the strongest paired comparator mean in each of episodes 2 and 3
go_no_go.mean_gain_gate: Across episodes 2 and 3, DCTPR mean gain over the strongest paired comparator is at least 1.0 percentage point
go_no_go.practical_gain_gate: DCTPR exceeds BL nearest support by at least 5.0 percentage points in each episode
go_no_go.on_go: provisional method GO; implement external transductive baselines and a second fine-grained dataset before any paper claim or official-test access
go_no_go.on_no_go: close DCTPR and do not continue capacity/transduction variants

forbidden_claims: Do not claim Sinkhorn, prototype refinement, or feature concatenation as individually novel
Do not claim state of the art without TIM, LaplacianShot, PT-MAP-family and recent transductive comparisons
Do not claim robustness to imbalanced query priors from balanced episodes
Do not access CUB official test during this confirmation
